The low M15 ATR of 0.00029 indicates a compression phase, suggesting that a high-velocity expansion downward is imminent once the defensive staff is mitigated.

Confluence 5: The 1.16250 key quarter level acts as a psychological barrier, reinforced by the MSNR resistance and the upper boundary of the CRT range. VPVR shows a high-volume node (POC) just below this level, indicating that institutional sellers are defending this zone. The lack of buying volume on the retracement confirms that the move is corrective, validating a preemptive sell-limit order.
